subject: general
question: 'Operation Vijay' is associated with which of the following wars?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kargil War-1999**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Operation Vijay** is associated with the **Kargil War-1999**.
 
• The Kargil War was fought between **India and Pakistan** in the Kargil district of Jammu and Kashmir and elsewhere along the Line of Control (LoC).
 
• It took place between **May and July 1999**.
 
• The operation aimed to clear the Kargil sector of infiltrators from the Pakistani Army.
 
• Indian forces successfully regained the high outposts, leading to a **decisive victory**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The conflict is also referred to as the **Kargil conflict**.
 
• It marked the first direct conflict between India and Pakistan since the **1971 Indo-Pakistan War**.
 
• The war highlighted the need for **high-altitude warfare** training and better surveillance and intelligence.
 
• The success of Operation Vijay boosted the morale of the Indian Armed Forces and enhanced India's military reputation globally.
